newsitem.title: SPAIN: Mar CPI to boost Spain stocks, Wall St permitting.
newsitem.headline: Mar CPI to boost Spain stocks, Wall St permitting.

text.p: If forecasts for benign Spanish inflation in March prove correct the indicator should boost the stock market on Friday, but only if Wall Street performs well, dealers said on Thursday.
"If the (Consumer Price Index) is good and Wall Street doesn't give us a shock we could see a clearly higher response from the bourse" said a dealer at brokerage Eurosafei.
The market is discounting a rise in the CPI of around 0.2 percent from February. This would give a year-on-year rate of 2.4 percent or lower, versus 2.5 percent in February.
But the range of forecasts from economists surveyed by Reuters showed predictions as low as 2.1 percent.
Better figures could pave the way for a fresh rate cut at the April 15 regular repo auction, they said.
A Renta 4 dealer said there may not necessarily be a strong stock market reaction even if the data show tame prices growth.
"February CPI was excellent and the stock market's response was minimised by the fall in the New York stock exchange," he said.
